dedupe_keys.name: instituto nacional de estatistica drinking water datasets

description: Instituto Nacional de Estatística: drinking water datasets is a collection of datasets listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Instituto Nacional de Estatística. Coverage: Instituto Nacional de Estatística. The listing groups 9 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about drinking water; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Proveitos das entidades gestoras com o serviço de abastecimento de águ; Rubricas contabilisticas das entidades gestoras com o serviço de abast; Perdas nos sistemas de abastecimento de água (Série 2011 - m³); População servida por sistemas de abastecimento de água (Série 2006-20. Formats seen: JSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
